title: Deliver adaptive, verified orchestration in RapidLM
completion_rule: Mark a task complete only with evidence. Overall completion requires all required functional, live evaluation, platform, documentation and release-decision evidence. Do not infer runtime configuration or scheduling from this planning artifact.

tasks.title: Audit current baseline and map existing work
implementation: Record commit, dirty state, supported platforms and current entry-point call paths.
Recheck research gaps against source; map existing V3 task IDs and already-delivered functionality.
validation: Produce a source-linked baseline/ownership matrix and preserve unrelated working changes.
evidence: docs/goals/gvs5h-phase0-baseline-2026-09-17.md — baseline commit, dirty state, platform contract (Windows now a test gate), entry-point call paths, every research lead rechecked against source with file:line, existing-work map with reachability, V3 manifest discrepancies (P2-007/P2-023), source ownership matrix

tasks.title: Specify architecture and compatibility contracts
implementation: Record an ADR for extending the existing graph/supervisor rather than adding an engine.
Define record ownership, lifecycle, publication reconciliation, config precedence and schema/migration strategy.
validation: Trace every proposed authoritative mutation to an existing owner; document handling of old data and clients.
evidence: docs/adrs/0021-verified-orchestration-extends-graph-and-supervisor.md — extend Supervisor/GraphService/TransactionManager rather than add an engine; record ownership and versioned shapes; lifecycle mapping (Paused added); normative publication ordering with journal reconciliation; config precedence and CLI override; additive schema/migration strategy with typed unsupported-replay outcome

tasks.title: Preregister evaluation and freeze baseline
implementation: Pin baseline build, dataset splits, grader version, controlled arms and model/backend settings.
Declare aggregate budgets, statistical method, promotion gates, development-versus-held-out separation and provenance fields.
validation: Retain experiment protocol before tuning; verify no held-out answer leakage into task packets.
evidence: docs/evaluation-specs/gvs5h-experiment-preregistration.md — frozen promotion gates (quality/efficiency routes, latency and correctness guards), pinned grader v2 and splits, 64-task shard rule, arms A–F, task-clustered bootstrap statistics, provenance fields, leakage controls, amendment log

tasks.title: Define versioned orchestration records
implementation: Extend existing ID/schema types for run, attempt, finding, candidate, check, verdict, reservation and decision records.
Reference large bodies through existing artifact storage; implement bounds, redaction and additive evolution.
validation: Round-trip schemas; reject invalid IDs/oversized content; test old-reader/new-reader compatibility and fixture changes.

tasks.title: Persist and replay complete graph state
implementation: Persist sufficient graph/proposal data or immutable references for reconstruction.
Rebuild definitions, revisions, node states and orchestration projections; handle historical missing payloads explicitly.
validation: Restart after each durable transition; compare replayed and uninterrupted state; inject duplicate, missing and corrupt records.

tasks.title: Make acceptance and publication recovery-safe
implementation: Refactor acceptance into durable event-derived transitions shared by graph and goal projections.
Define prepared/applied/reconciled publication receipts and idempotent request handling across database/filesystem boundaries.
validation: Inject append failures and crashes around publication; assert no false completion, split projections or double patch application.

tasks.title: Bind evidence to real identities and invalidate on writes
implementation: Compute canonical candidate, test-definition and relevant environment digests instead of goal-metadata identity.
Wire production workspace and dependency changes to evidence/finding invalidation.
validation: Modify code, tests and relevant environment after verification; refuse stale acceptance and retain unaffected evidence where justified.

tasks.title: Recover runs, reservations and uncertain effects
implementation: Restore active work as paused and reconcile attempts, child resources and prepared effects.
Recover budget reservations and artifact references without replaying uncertain external effects.
validation: Kill/restart at queued, running, checking, acceptance and publication boundaries; require paused recovery and explicit reconciliation.

tasks.title: Capture correct isolated candidate snapshots
implementation: Snapshot authorized staged, unstaged and relevant untracked content from the actual starting workspace.
Use actual attempt/agent/view identities and preserve baseline provenance for each child; reject unsupported isolation.
validation: Run children on dirty workspaces and successive candidates; prove user changes are preserved and parallel writers share no mutable view.

tasks.title: Preserve incumbents and stage candidate publication
implementation: Keep immutable candidate patches with predecessor/check references and an incumbent selection policy.
Stage integration against an expected parent snapshot; retain failed/conflicting candidates without modifying the parent.
validation: Reject regression candidates, concurrent parent edits and conflicting patches; verify publication receipts and incumbent retention.

tasks.title: Implement versioned working findings
implementation: Persist supported/refuted/superseded findings, source references, dependency hashes and negative results.
Build bounded run-state and human-readable note projections from existing stores; never treat exports as authority.
validation: Replay findings after restart; exclude stale dependencies; retain superseded evidence; show edited exports cannot change task acceptance.

tasks.title: Compile fresh role-specific context
implementation: Compile objectives, constraints, selected code, findings, gaps and candidate refs using existing token/output reserves.
Create separate worker, planner, verifier and alternative-attempt views without full parent transcripts.
validation: Force context pressure and truncation; preserve mandatory requirements/rules/evidence and reject oversized packets rather than silently dropping obligations.

tasks.title: Implement live typed role drivers
implementation: Provide planner, explorer/retriever, implementer, verifier and strategist adapters over the existing live executor.
Apply correct AgentRole, tool projection, capability ceilings, structured parsing and bounded malformed-output repair.
validation: Exercise production adapters with deterministic malformed/correct outputs and live smoke; prove proposals alone cannot mutate host authority.

tasks.title: Connect bounded deterministic check execution
implementation: Run checks through shared supervised process and policy paths; drain bounded output and clean process groups.
Emit candidate-bound receipts with exit/timeout/cancel status, check identity and required discovery/behavior evidence.
validation: Reject matching stdout plus nonzero exit, timeout, missing discovery and prohibited actions; verify bounded output and cancellation cleanup.

tasks.title: Enforce independent verification for every candidate
implementation: Use a fresh read-only verifier packet and requirement-linked deterministic evidence to create verdicts/gaps.
Make changed finalization, repair and merge candidates pass identical gates; prevent self-reports from satisfying evidence.
validation: Reject false done, stale identity, dangling evidence and unchecked finalizer output; prove verifier writes fail at the executor boundary.

tasks.title: Enforce shared run budget reservations
implementation: Reserve run-wide token/cost/time/tool/concurrency capacity before every call or check, including a verification reserve.
Settle every attempt and retry idempotently; preserve unknown usage and reconcile interrupted requests.
validation: Stress simultaneous reservations, provider retries and late settlements; no per-child budget reset, double settlement or free finalizer.

tasks.title: Deliver sequential graph-backed pilot
implementation: Map live role/check/verification attempts onto canonical graph revisions and bridge the existing workflow runner.
Execute plan-to-worker-to-check-to-verdict-to-publish with one model and one writer; keep deterministic transitions model-free.
validation: Complete a real multi-file task through the production entry point; replay its run and verify all calls, receipts and publication identity.

tasks.title: Add bounded adaptive effort and replanning
implementation: Select direct versus full workflow using a recorded inspectable policy and configured ceilings.
Use gap/check/patch/evidence stagnation signals to repair or replan by appending revisions, with finite convergence limits.
validation: Test simple tasks avoid unnecessary manager calls; repeated unchanged failures trigger a justified new action; all paths terminate within bounds.

tasks.title: Add fresh alternative attempts and evidence-based selection
implementation: Dispatch a bounded alternative with earlier proposed solutions omitted but user rules and verified repository facts retained.
Select challengers using the same checks and acceptance policy; treat agreement or confidence as insufficient proof.
validation: Seed an incorrect early plan; inspect alternative packet independence and show an unverified challenger cannot displace the incumbent.

tasks.title: Wire purpose-aware model profile routing
implementation: Carry plan/code/review purposes and configured role profiles into actual provider requests.
Respect supported reasoning/structured-output capabilities and explicit fallback policy; record routes and retry spend.
validation: Capture provider-bound requests to prove routes are used; test unsupported settings, fallback attribution and shared-budget enforcement.

tasks.title: Enable safe selective concurrency
implementation: Schedule bounded parallel read-only tasks and isolated candidate attempts with shared resource reservations.
Compose accepted changes in a staging view and rerun integration checks even for non-overlapping file edits.
validation: Exercise overlap, cross-file API regression, resource starvation and failed children; prove isolation and no unverified integration.

tasks.title: Complete lifecycle propagation and resumable child handling
implementation: Unify pause/cancel/approval/input waits and resume through existing parent/child registries and graph state.
Fence late child results and publication; retain useful artifacts and release resources/reservations correctly.
validation: Cancel parent and child at each phase, restart during approval wait and deliver late completion; no unauthorized replay or publication.

tasks.title: Expose configuration and CLI/headless/workflow entry
implementation: Preserve off/verified mode and add bounded strategy settings and execution overrides with existing precedence.
Route all exposed entry points through the same host; remove unchecked child auto-integration from verified paths.
validation: CLI contract tests cover enable/disable, invalid settings, managed ceilings, headless verification and unchanged off-mode behavior.

tasks.title: Integrate terminal status and control
implementation: Render active task, candidate, check/verdict state, remaining budget and meaningful strategy changes from projections.
Connect inspect/pause/cancel/resume to existing actions and persist effective run config at safe boundaries.
validation: Drive the real interactive dispatcher through success, repair, pause/resume and cancel; UI never invents completion or leaks secrets.

tasks.title: Expose shared adapter and SDK contracts
implementation: Expose applicable run controls/events/results through existing daemon/ACP/SDK paths and truthful capability negotiation.
Generate additive wire types and fixtures; preserve old-client behavior when orchestration is unavailable or off.
validation: Run adapter round-trip, version-compatibility, capability-advertisement and generated-schema drift checks.

tasks.title: Document user flows and delivered architecture
implementation: Write enabling, inspecting, resuming and interpreting evidence examples using actual delivered commands.
Update stale architecture claims, role/tool policy, defaults, unsupported surfaces and upstream attribution where material was reused.
validation: Check examples against implemented help/config contracts and source links; remove claims of unmeasured improvement.

tasks.title: Implement controlled evaluation arms and complete accounting
implementation: Add baseline, sequential, enhanced, independent-sampling and mixed-route arms with fixed task/model/tool provenance.
Support deterministic sharding or a validated loader limit change; account for all attempts, cache/retry usage and missing measurements.
validation: Negative controls reject missing arms, all-skipped reports, silent truncation and false verified-success metrics; shards aggregate without duplicates.

tasks.title: Build development and held-out task suites
implementation: Create the 24-task development pilot and at least 100 independent held-out repository tasks across required languages and behaviors.
Keep hidden grading outside agent-visible workspaces; add discovery, protected-file and mutation checks plus positive controls.
validation: Gold fixes pass and vacuous/wrong/tampered submissions fail; verify task independence, split integrity and lack of answer leakage.

tasks.title: Exercise required negative and chaos matrix
implementation: Implement the goal's 20 failure scenarios at production boundaries using fault injection and real workspace/process behavior.
Retain reproducible artifacts and assertions tying user-visible state to ledger/evidence truth.
validation: Every required negative case and corresponding positive control passes; replay/crash probes do not rely solely on in-memory fakes.

tasks.title: Run repeated held-out live experiments
implementation: Use available configured providers under an explicit experiment spending ceiling; capture model/backend and environment identities.
Run preregistered same-model and mixed-route arms with repeated trials and preserve failures, charges, partial usage and latency.
validation: Required arms actually execute; retain exact configs, predictions and external grader results; report missing dependencies without substituting offline evidence.

tasks.title: Analyze benefit and record release decision
implementation: Compute paired task-level uncertainty, all-attempt cost per verified success and median/p95 latency.
Apply frozen quality/efficiency/correctness/latency gates; document promotion, experimental-only or do-not-promote outcome and any bounded follow-up tuning.
validation: An independent recalculation matches report totals; no selective exclusions, pooled incompatible budgets or unsupported quality claims.

tasks.title: Complete final repository and platform checks
implementation: Run relevant targeted checks, then required fmt/lint/workspace/schema/SDK gates on the delivered code.
Validate supported platform behavior and off-mode regressions; use equivalent retained CI evidence if local infrastructure prevents execution.
validation: All required supported-platform gates pass at the relevant commit; informational or unexecuted checks remain explicitly labelled.

tasks.title: Rehearse migration, disable and recovery runbooks
implementation: Test upgrade from historical state, disabling new runs, draining/cancelling active work and recovery from interrupted migration.
Define downgrade compatibility and preserve artifacts; never promise old binaries can read unsupported new state.
validation: Run documented upgrade/recovery/disable scenarios on retained fixtures; no data loss, autonomous resumed work or stranded publication.

tasks.title: Assemble acceptance evidence and final handoff
implementation: Link all 26 criteria and 34 tasks to code revisions, tests, durable artifacts and live results; reconcile existing project tracking.
Deliver configuration/migration examples, limitations and release decision; mark goal complete only after every required deliverable has evidence.
validation: Acceptance matrix has no unexplained gaps; final claims match the exact evaluated/delivered versions and ordinary execution remains compatible.

phase_notes.note: First slice per ADR 0021 (production caller before persistence): `rapid run --orchestration verified` drives a playbook through scheduler::GraphService/GraphBackedRun (apps/rapid/src/workflow_verified.rs); every step transition is a durable graph event, the verification steps are the supervisor's contract, and `verified` is the supervisor's acceptance. Not a GVS-004..008 completion: replay (GVS-005), single-event acceptance (GVS-006), real identities (GVS-007) and recovery (GVS-008) remain pending; the run-state file now carries the graph/session pointer they need.

Second slice per ADR 0021 (payload-complete events + reducer): `GraphCreated` now carries the whole `graph`, `GraphRevisionCommitted` the validated `proposal` (crates/scheduler/src/service.rs); `GraphService::replay(session) -> GraphReplay` rebuilds the live `graphs` map from a session's durable events alone, re-applying proposals through the same `validate_and_apply` and folding node-state/attempts changes. A pre-payload `graph.created`/`graph.revision_committed` reduces to `GraphReplay::Unsupported { first_seq }` rather than a guess (nothing in production created graphs before this, so no real history is affected). Tested: a restart after a create/propose/fan-out/run/fail/retry history replays byte-identical to the uninterrupted graph, and a pre-payload event yields Unsupported. Not yet a resume-time caller: `VerifiedRun` still mirrors the run-state file (GVS-006 single-event acceptance and GVS-008 recovery are the reducer's consumers, next in the order). GVS-005 partial: replay proven; the acceptance criterion's crash-at-each-boundary matrix lands with GVS-008.
